title: ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5080 OC — TechFuelHQ First-Party Bench Dataset

version_history.note: Initial publication with 6 charts: generational positioning, Time Spy stock-vs-OC, clock headroom, thermals/power, DLSS 4 MFG Cyberpunk, 4K native gaming 8-game gauntlet.

PR K expansion: full 5-test synthetic ladder (Time Spy, Time Spy Extreme, Port Royal, Speed Way, Steel Nomad) x 3 tune tiers (Stock / Factory OC / Manual OC) = 15 new first-party data points. 4K gaming chart re-shot with 5 configurations across 3 games plus 1% lows (Cyberpunk Ultra raster, Cyberpunk RT DLSS-Q, Cyberpunk PT native, Alan Wake 2 RT DLSS-Q, Wukong Cinematic). DLSS 4 MFG ladder expanded to a 4-mode ladder (Native PT, DLSS-Q no FG, MFG 2x, MFG 4x) with PC Latency overlay (Reflex on). Power & Thermal converted to side-by-side comparison of two TechFuelHQ-measured profiles on the same Astral card.
Added JSON and CSV exports of the owner's existing subjective coil-whine observation for the same physical card. No benchmark values or benchmark provenance changed.

Qualified the five June gaming configurations (three games) with the hand-tuned GPU profile, and distinguished native rendering, DLSS Quality and unspecified settings. The original v1.4.0 export is retained. No new test and no change to any measured value.

methodology_notes: Every measurement on this page is a TechFuelHQ first-party run on Lowell K. Wood IV's home test bench in St. Louis County, MO.
Thermals and board power captured with HWiNFO64 during sustained-load runs.
Board power is read at the GPU sensor (board power, not wall power).
OC tuning done in ASUS GPU Tweak III; no shunt mods, no LN2, no driver hacks.

Three tune profiles per synthetic test: Stock (out-of-box defaults), Factory OC (the ASUS-shipped OC profile / silent BIOS), and Manual OC (hand-tuned offsets in GPU Tweak III User Mode 2: +328 MHz core, +2996 MHz memory, +12% power target).
Cyberpunk 2077 runs use the in-game benchmark scene at 3840x2160 native, max preset, RT Overdrive where indicated.
DLSS 4 MFG ladder uses the in-game benchmark scene with DLSS Quality + Reflex on; FPS and PC Latency captured together.
Power & Thermal is a side-by-side comparison of two TechFuelHQ-measured profiles on the same Astral card: Astral Stock (out-of-box defaults) and Astral Manual OC (User Mode 2 offsets above).

Generational Positioning index normalizes 4K rasterization throughput to RTX 4080 Super = 100. All four index points are TechFuelHQ first-party: the Astral 5080 OC on the current bench, and the RTX 4080, RTX 4080 Super, and RTX 5080 FE measured on the retired 2024-2025 bench.
